headline: Revised discrimination and harassment complaint procedures, FY 26 fund balance estimates, enrollment update, and staff appointments.
summary: The agenda lists second readings of seven revised policies, including complaint procedures for student and employee discrimination and harassment. It also covers staff appointments, a beginning-of-year report from principals, an enrollment update, and FY 26 fund balance estimates.
items: Consent agenda: nomination of Arija Grant, BHS ESOL Teacher

Consent agenda: appointments of Emily St. Peter (BIS Ed Tech III), Marina Frederick (BMS Admin Assistant School Year), Helen Hartnett (BPS Cook), Olivier Umumararungue (BHS Custodian), Ana Mbala (BMS Custodian), Susan Philips (BHS Nutrition), Jeanne Boissonneault (BPS Nutrition), and Rebecca Lauze (BIS Ed Tech II), plus one School Committee appointment
Consent agenda: transfer of Izaiah Stackpole from BMS Ed Tech II to BMS Ed Tech I FLS
Committee reports, including the Advisory Committee on Policy summary of the August 12 meeting
New business: beginning of year report from principals
New business: FY 26 fund balance estimates
Second reading of ACAA-R, Student Discrimination and Harassment Complaint Procedure
Second reading of ACAA-R2, Student Sex Discrimination/Harassment Complaint Procedure
Second reading of ACAB-R1, Employee Discrimination and Harassment Complaint Procedure
Second reading of ACAB-R2, Employee Sex Discrimination/Harassment Complaint Procedure
Second reading of DJ-R, Federal Procurement Manual (2025)
Second reading of EBCF, AED's and CPR
Second reading of IHBAC, Child Find (2025)
